_doc: Render massing for De Wildernis (adventure playground and youth centre on the island in the Gebroeders Van Raemdonckpark, Lode de Boningelaan; Nominatim 'Wildernis', amenity=community_centre), read by pipeline/src/scene.ts. GRB 7780907 (bijgebouw, 25.5 x 8.7 m) got 14 m from the DHMV II DSM p95: the hut is newer than the survey (the footprint interior is ~0 m in the nDSM) and the p95 picked up the tree crowns around it, so the painter made a 4-storey brick block of it (Tom's feedback, 2026-11-13). Metres in Lambert 72 around 'anchor', u along 'axis_deg' 120.7 (the long side). Look: low, worn timber huts of a construction playground (web: Issuu booklet 'wildernis'); height not measured, a one-storey hut with a pitched roof is assumed.
